dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent ring-like structures exhibit a sharp, irregular gradient transition from the dark-pigmented exterior base fur to the high-intensity light-colored rings. These perimeters are characterized by jagged, high-frequency pixel intensity changes forming closed circular and partially open 'C' geometries with jagged internal and external margins.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a moderate density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters localized primarily in the anterior dorsal region near the neck and along the lower caudal-lateral flank. These clusters lack internal dark cores and appear as asymmetrical, localized concentrations of light-toned pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest centrally located macro-annuli form a clear obtuse scalene triangle. A separate group of four smaller blobs and rings along the mid-spinal axis forms a roughly linear geometric relationship following the longitudinal body curve.
